thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 12/14/2018: SHOP, INFY, QCOM, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/14/2018: SHOP, INFY, QCOM, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -1.02%
AAPL: -1.11%
IBM: Flat
CSCO: -2.28%
GOOG: -1.12%
Most technology stocks were retreating in Friday's pre-bell trading.
Early movers include:
(-) Shopify ( SHOP ), which was more than 7% lower after it launched an offering of 2.6 million Class A subordinate voting shares. It expects to use the net proceeds to strengthen its balance sheet, providing flexibility to fund its growth strategies.
In other sector news:
(=) Infosys ( INFY ) was unchanged after saying it established a joint venture with Hitachi Ltd., Panasonic Corp. and Pasona Inc. as it seeks to expand its footprint in Japan.
(+) Qualcomm ( QCOM ) and VinSmart, a wholly owned subsidiary of Vietnamese conglomerate VinGroup, signed a patent licensing agreement, which covers multimode complete terminals. Qualcomm was 1% lower in Friday's pre-market trading .
